en.headline: WestK picnic series holds its last weekend at Art Park
en.dek: The West Kowloon Cultural District's picnic programme returns from 2pm to 9pm on Friday, Saturday and Sunday, and ends on 11 October.
body: The West Kowloon Cultural District's WestK Picnic Fest holds its final weekend this Friday to Sunday at the Harbourside East Lawn in Art Park. The district authority said the sessions run from 2pm to 9pm on 9, 10 and 11 October, and that the series ends on 11 October.

WestK said the programme, which began on 18 September, has been staged on weekends and public holidays at the lawn. It described the line-up as a gourmet market, themed workshops and live music. A Kowloon Walled City food stall, offering local street-food items, is listed for 1 to 4 October and again for 9 to 11 October.

The authority said it is partnering with The Picnic Club Hong Kong on a series of picnic workshops. The event page does not state a ticket price. The lawn is in the Art Park at the West Kowloon Cultural District.

zh.headline: 西九野餐祭本周末最後一輪在藝術公園舉行
zh.dek: 西九文化區表示，野餐祭星期五至日下午2時至9時在藝術公園海濱東草坪舉行，系列於11日結束。
body: 西九文化區的「西九野餐祭」本星期五至日在藝術公園海濱東草坪舉行本季最後一個周末場次。西九表示，10月9至11日的時段為下午2時至9時，整個系列於10月11日結束。
西九稱，活動由9月18日起，在周末及公眾假期於草坪舉行，內容包括美食市集、主題工作坊及現場音樂。一個以九龍寨城為題的街檔，售賣本地街頭小食，檔期列為10月1至4日及9至11日。
西九表示，工作坊部分與The Picnic Club Hong Kong合作。活動頁沒有列出門票價錢。場地在西九文化區藝術公園的海濱東草坪。
